newsitem.title: USA: DavCo to acquire some Friendly's Restaurants.
newsitem.headline: DavCo to acquire some Friendly's Restaurants.

text.p: DavCo Restaurants Inc., the nation's largest franchisee of Wendy's International Inc. fast-food restaurants, said Monday it will purchase 34 Friendly's Restaurants.
It did not disclose financial terms of the agreement.

Under the deal with Friendly's Restaurants Franchise Inc. and Friendly Ice Cream Corp., DavCo said its subsidiary, FriendCo Restaurants Inc. will acquire the 34 Friendly's Restaurants and will also manage 14 other Friendly's.
In addition, FriendCo will have the rights to open up to an additional 100 Friendly's Restaurants over the next 10 years.
DavCo operates 229 Wendy's restaurants in Maryland, northern Virginia, the District of Columbia, metropolitan St. Louis, central Illinois and Nashville, Tenn.
DavCo's stock was unchanged at $10.875 on the American Stock Exchange.
